# Veggie Tokri

> Freshness, Ready for Your Kitchen.

This file describes the public Veggie Tokri website at https://veggietokri.com/ for people and tools that prefer a concise Markdown overview. Pack sizes, prices, inventory, delivery fees, and service areas are shown on the live site and checkout; only indexable public pages from the current catalogue are linked below. Publishing this file does not affect search or AI inclusion.

## Main Website

- [Homepage](https://veggietokri.com/): Storefront home with category navigation and published products.
- [FAQs](https://veggietokri.com/faqs.php): Help articles about orders, delivery, and payments (content managed in admin).

## Product Categories

- [Fresh & Chopped](https://veggietokri.com/category.php?slug=fresh-chopped): Published category page.
- [Ready-to-Cook Combos](https://veggietokri.com/category.php?slug=ready-to-cook-combos): Published category page.

Published products allowed for search indexing (active variant, visible category, indexable SEO).

## Shopping and Ordering

- Shoppers add items from product pages, review the cart, and complete checkout on the website when logged in and when delivery rules allow the saved address.
- FAQs explain variants, payments, and retries when applicable.
- Subscription purchase and management require a customer account; subscription checkout URLs are not listed here.

## Customer Support

- [Contact](https://veggietokri.com/contact.php): Support phone, email, and WhatsApp when configured in business settings.
- [Support tickets](https://veggietokri.com/support.php): Form to raise help requests; logged-in customers can link an order when applicable.

## Optional

- [XML sitemap](https://veggietokri.com/sitemap.xml): Indexable storefront URLs regenerated from the database.
- [llms.txt](https://veggietokri.com/llms.txt): This overview file.
